I do have several copies of this that originally came from a game store and the seams on the shrink wrap are identical and appear to be machine processed , See pics closely! Thanks for stopping by , all questions welcome!

original265.ebayDescriptionText: NEW FACTORY SEALED Prince of Persia Classic Trilogy HD 2011 Sony PlayStation 3 PS3 Video Game Prepare for daring action, astonishing acrobatics and challenging missions as you dive into the excitement of the Prince of Persia Trilogy. Totally remastered for your PlayStation 3, the classic The Sands of Time, Warrior Within and The Two Thrones titles return with smoother, more spotless gameplay than ever at 60 frames per second, and immerse you in the action with the vibrancy of a full 1080p resolution. Become the master of your own dark powers as you venture into cursed palace chambers, aided by a seductive princess along the way. Ensure your safety and that of your kingdom by evading the Dahaka, facing mankind's greatest fears and engaging in intense combat with your enemies. Will you have the strength of body and mind it will take to restore peace to your homeland? The product is a brand new, factory sealed Prince of Persia Trilogy for Sony PlayStation 3. Released in 2011 by Ubisoft, this action and adventure game is rated M for Mature audiences. The game features the Prince of Persia series and includes the manual. This product is specifically designed for NTSC-U/C regions (US/Canada) and is a great addition to any video game collection.

original265.ebayDescriptionText: Offered here is a sealed vintage big box edition of Myth: The Total Codex, released by Bungie in 1999 as The Complete Myth Collection. Designed for PC and Mac, this classic real-time tactics compilation brings together the full Myth: The Fallen Lords and Myth II: Soulblighter games alongside the Myth II: Chimera scenario pack. Per the box packaging, the set also includes the official strategy guides for both Myth and Myth II on CD, built-in campaign editors, and dozens of user-created multiplayer scenarios. The outer box remains sealed, featuring the original gatefold flap cover and vibrant 1990s artwork. Please examine all photos carefully to assess the seal and any light shelf, edge, or corner wear consistent with a vintage cardboard release. Because this is an original 1999 software release, modern operating systems or compatibility tools may be required to run the games on contemporary hardware. This item will be carefully wrapped and shipped inside a sturdy box to ensure the big box arrives safely without crushing or corner damage.

We do not provide actual pictures, but we will choose the best condition item available to our customers on first come first serve basis. Most of our merchandises are factory sealed, but if you found they are not factory sealed, it is most likely due to either our distributor's inspection or that is how they came in. Additional Item Details: N/A Shipping and Payments: Click on tab "Shipping and payments" next to Description tab for all of our S&H fee schedule, payment methods, and return policies. We DO NOT combine shipping. We accept Paypal only.  We generally accept all returns for any reasons as long as the item is still in the original condition and within 30 days of your purchase. Cancellation Fees: Selecting "Buy It Now" acknowledges that you agree to our terms and accept our postal charges. There is NO shopping cart where you can still back out. Cancellation fee is $3 per item or ebay final value fee whichever is higher. A Non-Paying Bidder claim will be filed when you fail to meet your obligation to send payment. Feedback s: A positive feedback is always greatly appreciated. We will give a positive feedback automatically once we received your payment and positive feedback. Please let us know your dissatisfaction before you leave a negative feedback.   Disclaimers : Choking Hazards: Most of our merchandises may contain sharp points, small parts that can cause choking hazards, and other elements that are not suitable for children under 3 years of age. Please provide adult supervision. Other Important Notes: Due to increased sales, our domestic handling time is between 1 - 3 business days with average of 2 business days. For international shipment, we may have to wait longer to avoid fraudulent activities. Our international shipment handling time is between 1 - 5 business days with average of 3 business days. Estimated delivery time under "Shipping and payments" tab is provided by US Post Office. It is provided as a reference, not a guaranteed delivery date, as USPS often misses its estimated delivery date. It may also be inaccurate, for example, First Class and Priority Mail should not have the same estimated delivery date, but the posted estimated delivery date the same for both. We do not guarantee delivery date for every transaction. If you need the item by a certain date , please contact us to confirm that we can deliver it by the date. Normal delivery time is about 2 - 3 weeks to most foreign countries , but sometimes longer depending on your local custom office policies. We ask you to wait at least 1 month from shipped date before you file a claim or dispute. Based on our experience shipping to Brazil and other South America countries, please allow up to 2 months for delivery. During our busiest quarter (Nov, Dec, and Jan), we ask our customers to be more patience as packages are often time get delayed.

This offering is the physical game cartridge in its original Nintendo Switch case, supplied separately from the Starter Pack. The packaging states that an internet download of at least 4 GB is required, a microSD card may be needed, and an internet connection and Ubisoft account are required to play. Explore the Atlas star system as part of a team of interstellar pilots fighting Grax and the Forgotten Legion. Travel across alien planets and into space, complete missions, and customize your starship and weapon loadouts for different encounters. The Nintendo Switch version brings Fox McCloud and the Arwing into the adventure, along with exclusive Star Fox missions. Play solo or team up in two-player local split-screen co-op. The game supports digital play without attaching physical starship toys, making it possible to enjoy its space battles and exploration with standard Switch controls. Players follow Mama's instructions to prepare a variety of dishes, completing different cooking steps through the Nintendo DS touchscreen and stylus. Activities include chopping, mixing, stirring, frying, and other food preparation tasks, with each recipe broken down into interactive mini-games. This installment features more than 80 recipes to prepare, along with additional cooking challenges and opportunities to improve your culinary skills. Players can also share their creations and compete with friends using the game's multiplayer features. With its colorful presentation, approachable gameplay, and wide variety of recipes, Cooking Mama 2: Dinner With Friends is an entertaining addition to the Nintendo DS library. original265.ebayDescriptionText: Developed by Blue Tongue Entertainment and published by THQ in 2004 , The Polar Express is a 3D action-adventure game based on the Warner Bros. animated holiday film inspired by Chris Van Allsburg's beloved children's book. Players take the role of the Hero Boy on a magical train journey to the North Pole, encountering familiar characters, recovering missing tickets, and overcoming obstacles along the way. Spanning eight chapters, the adventure combines exploration, platforming, rhythm challenges, puzzles, and interactive mini-games. Activities include navigating the train's rooftops, confronting the mischievous Scrooge puppet, skiing through snowy environments, and exploring the North Pole. The game recreates memorable locations and characters from the film while incorporating a variety of family-oriented challenges. The Polar Express arrived in 2004 alongside the theatrical release of Robert Zemeckis' computer-animated holiday film, which became particularly notable for its extensive use of performance-capture technology. Based on Chris Van Allsburg's award-winning 1985 picture book, the property expanded into interactive entertainment through THQ's licensed adaptation. The game reflects the early-2000s trend of bringing major Hollywood family films into 3D interactive adventures, combining recognizable cinematic characters and environments with accessible action and mini-game mechanics. Its connection to a widely recognized Christmas story and its original film-era release give it a distinctive place among holiday-themed video games and licensed entertainment collectibles. Collectors interested in The Polar Express may also want to explore The Grinch ( 2000 ), another Christmas-themed adventure combining exploration and platforming; Finding Nemo ( 2003 ), a THQ-published animated-film adaptation featuring underwater exploration and action challenges; The Incredibles: When Danger Calls ( 2004 ), another THQ family-film tie-in built around character-themed mini-games; Charlie and the Chocolate Factory ( 2005 ), a fantasy adventure adapted from another major family film; and Barnyard ( 2006 ), a later film-based adventure developed by Blue Tongue Entertainment and published by THQ. Session: Skate Sim (XSX) Product Details Compatible Devices: Windows Controller Type: Gamepad Connectivity Technology: Bluetooth Additional Features: Ergonomic Button Quantity: 20 Hardware Platform: Xbox One, Xbox Series X Power Source: Battery Powered Compatible Video Game Console Models: Microsoft Xbox One, Microsoft Xbox One S, Microsoft Xbox One X, Microsoft Xbox SERIES X Package Quantity: 1 Item Dimensions: 7.5 x 5.24 x 0.39 inches Color: multi-colored Brand Name: Maximum Entertainment Model Name: Session: Skate Sim Manufacturer: Maximum Games Global Trade Identification Number: 78 UPC: 814290018061 814290018078 Item Type Name: Video Game Model Number: 351807 Unit Count: 1 Count Manufacturer Part Number: MXG351807XB1 AUTHENTIC GAMEPLAY: With the dual stick controls, each stick represents one of your feet; You will need to learn how to control them and transfer weight, just like on a real skateboard "IF IT WASN'T CAUGHT ON VIDEO, IT DIDN'T HAPPEN: Go from skater to filmmaker: pull off your moves then go into film mode to experience the action from the point of view of your camera operator and create the best clip CUSTOMIZATION: By completing challenges, you earn money to spend in skate shops where you can find nearly 200 items from top brands, such as Fallen and Zero; customize your skateboard with over 250 parts which will impact the way you skate Inspired by the golden age of street skating – the 1990s – Session: Skate Sim lets you experience true skateboarding and its culture. original265.ebayDescriptionText: Powered by Frooition RPGs (Role Playing Games) Board Games & Card Games Wargames Miniatures & Miniatures Games Art, Prints & Books CCGs (Collectible Card Games) Collectible Miniatures Game Comics Computer Games Dice Historical Books Historical Miniatures & Rules Magazines Movies, Toys, & More Novels Reference Books RPG Magazines Supplies Video Games Wargame Magazines Shop Categories RPGs (Role Playing Games) Board Games & Card Games Wargames Miniatures & Miniatures Games Art, Prints & Books CCGs (Collectible Card Games) Collectible Miniatures Game Comics Computer Games Dice Historical Books Historical Miniatures & Rules Magazines Movies, Toys, & More Novels Reference Books RPG Magazines Supplies Video Games Wargame Magazines Helpful Links Add to Favorite Sellers Sign up to Newsletter View Feedback Contact Seller Visit seller's eBay Shop About Seller Page Panzer Commander SW (VG+/New) Item Description Strategic Simulations Inc. SSI Computer War Games SSI Panzer Commander (SW (VG+/New)) Product Note: PC CD-Rom Manufacturer: Strategic Simulations Inc. SSI Product Line: Computer War Games SSI Type: Software (boxed) Copyright Date: 1998 Product Description: In Panzer Commander, the players can play selected missions or participate in one of six campaigns, each of which consists of a series of linked missions, the outcome of which will determine the course of the campaign. Players can play on either side and are given a selection of Axis and Allied tanks. Successful players are given command of a platoon of tanks. In Panzer General 2, players fight on the Living Battlefield. Featuring the heightened realism of hand-rendered maps--30 battlefields that are faithful to the real ones of WWII--the Living Battlefield also showcases detailed combat units. Battles rage through World War II's eastern and western fronts, northern Africa, and even the continental United States. Will you fight as a Wehrmacht officer, or perhaps lead your comrades in the Soviet Army? You may want to hit the beaches at Salerno and Normandy as an American or British general. No matter which path you choose, you will need all your skills to triumph. Please review the condition and any condition notes for the exact condition of this item. All pictures are stock photos. The condition of the item you will receive is SW (VG+/New) . Our grading system is listed below for your perusal. Grading System Grading System Payment Shipping About Returns Grading System Our Grading System   To ensure a smooth transaction, please review our grading system below as well as the Shipping Information tab before bidding. Be sure to review the exact condition (and any condition notes / incompleteness notes located next to the title and description) before purchase. All pictures are stock photos unless otherwise specified. SW  Shrink Wrapped. Still in the original factory shrink wrap, with any condition visible through shrink noted. For example, ?SW (NM)? means shrink wrapped in near-mint condition. MINT  Perfect. Brand new. NM  Near Mint. Like new with only the slightest wear, many times indistinguishable from a Mint item. Close to perfect, very collectible. Board & war games in this condition will show very little to no wear, and are considered to be "punched" unless the condition notes "unpunched." EX  Excellent. Lightly used, but almost like new. May show very small spine creases or slight corner wear. Absolutely no tears and no marks, a collectible condition. VG  Very Good. Used. May have medium-sized creases, corner dings, minor tears or scuff marks, small stains, etc. Complete and very useable. FAIR  Very well used, but complete and useable. May have flaws such as tears, pen marks or highlighting, large creases, stains, marks, etc. POOR  Extremely well used and has major flaws, which may be too numerous to mention. Item is complete unless noted. More Condition Details  Miniatures come unpainted and unassembled, unless specifically noted. Assembly is required for most miniatures and model kits. Boxed Items are listed as "code/code" where the first code represents the box, and the second code describes the contents. When only one condition is listed, then the box and contents are in the same condition. If a book is listed in the same fashion, the first code represents the cover, and the second code the interior. For example a boxed game listed as VG / NM indicates that the outer box is in Very Good Condition, while the contents are in Near Mint Condition. A "+" (plus) sign indicates that an item is close to the next highest condition. Example, EX+ is an item between Excellent and Near Mint condition. A "-" (minus) sign indicates the opposite. Major defects and/or missing components are noted separately. Boardgame Counters are punched, unless noted. Due to the nature of loose counters, if a game is unplayable we will send you the parts or it may be returned for a refund of the purchase price. Dice In most cases, boxed games and box sets do not come with dice. Cardboard Backing of miniature packs is not graded. If excessively worn, they will be marked as "card worn." Flat Trays for SPI games and similar are not graded. If excessively worn, they will be marked as "tray worn." Payment Payment We accept the following forms of payment: PayPal Visa, Mastercard, Discover and American Express credit cards In Store Pickup with payment on-site by cash or credit card Sales Tax For shipments to Wisconsin addresses, we are required by State law to collect a 5.5% Sales Tax. Shipping Shipping Domestic Combine & Save Feel free to combine items to save on shipping costs! Make sure to view all the shipping options we have available to save even further. Maximum Shipping Cost No matter how much you order you will never be charged more than $19.95 for shipping in the continental USA! Flat Shipping & UPS Ground Please note that if you select flat $19.95 shipping or UPS Ground shipping, your order will actually come via FedEx Ground, a similar service that allows us to offer you lower shipping rates that eBay does not list. Priority, Express and 1st Class Mail ship via the USPS. Your order will likely arrive in 3-10 business days. If it takes longer, please contact us so we can check with the carrier to locate your package. If it cannot be located within a week after this we will reship the order at NO charge to you. Tracking is available on all orders, except for extremely light packages like single Magic cards. International Combine & Save  Feel free to combine items to save on shipping costs! If you select USPS 1st Class   your order may ship via Fedex FIMS where Fedex delivers the package to your local post office and your local post office delivers the package.   This is a similar product that arrives in 7-21 days and allows us to offer you the lower shipping rate listed. USPS Priority and Express Mail packages will ship via the listed carriers but may also ship a faster method, at no extra charge. International Buyers  Please Note: Import duties, taxes, and charges are not included in the item price or shipping cost. These charges are the buyer's responsibility. Please check with your country's customs office to determine what these additional costs will be prior to bidding or buying. Surface Shipping We also have some  surface shipping  options available. Feel free to contact us if the cheapest international shipping is over $35 as we may able to save you 20% or more by shipping surface, as long as you are ok with the extra wait. Tracking is available for Express/DHL, limited or no tracking may be available for Priority, and 1st Class/ISAL. Attention: Buyers from France, Germany & Austria: Customers in these countries may be blocked from purchasing some historical items. eBay is very strict on allowing any WWII related merchandise to be sold to your country and we have been required to block all these listings. Please contact us for suggestions if you are interested in blocked items, as we have cast a wide net to avoid policy violations and some may be acceptable. original265.ebayDescriptionText: Brand new, factory sealed.  No rips/tears in plastic wrap but unfortunately the case was damaged at some point (pictured). All sealed games receive two layers of protective packaging. Each game is first placed inside a polybag that is folded over but left unsealed. This added layer helps prevent unnecessary wear or damage to the shrink wrap during transit while also making it easier for the buyer to remove the game without having to cut the packaging open and risk accidentally damaging the original wrap. For used games, we take the extra precaution of placing protective bubble material inside the case to help keep the disc securely in place during transit. Unfortunately, this is not possible with new, factory-sealed games without compromising the original packaging. As a result, there is always a possibility that the disc may become dislodged from its original seating during shipping. While we take every precaution to package items securely, this is an unavoidable risk when shipping sealed games. *A Note About Sealed Games* Our sealed games are not sold with the intention of being submitted for grading. We specialize in older games, and as a result, some items may exhibit varying degrees of shelf or storage wear, even if those imperfections are not clearly visible in the listing photos. Any noticeable rips or tears in the original plastic will be noted above, however, even when no damage is specifically mentioned, minor imperfections may still be present. Over time, small amounts of dust or debris can work their way beneath loose or imperfectly seated portions of the shrink wrap, including small flaps or ventilation holes. We strive to accurately represent the condition of every item, but please keep in mind that sealed games are older collectibles and may not have the pristine appearance of newly manufactured products. We encourage buyers to keep this in mind when purchasing. Please see all photos provided as they are of the actual item you will receive.  Feel free to reach out with any questions or to request additional photos PRIOR to purchasing.

Grading System Grading System Payment Shipping About Returns Grading System Our Grading System To ensure a smooth transaction, please review our grading system below as well as the Shipping Information tab before bidding. Be sure to review the exact condition (and any condition notes / incompleteness notes located next to the title and description) before purchase. All pictures are stock photos unless otherwise specified. SW Shrink Wrapped. Still in the original factory shrink wrap, with any condition visible through shrink noted. For example, ?SW (NM)? means shrink wrapped in near-mint condition. MINT Perfect. Brand new. NM Near Mint. Like new with only the slightest wear, many times indistinguishable from a Mint item. Close to perfect, very collectible. Board & war games in this condition will show very little to no wear, and are considered to be "punched" unless the condition notes "unpunched." EX Excellent. Lightly used, but almost like new. May show very small spine creases or slight corner wear. Absolutely no tears and no marks, a collectible condition. VG Very Good. Used. May have medium-sized creases, corner dings, minor tears or scuff marks, small stains, etc. Complete and very useable. FAIR Very well used, but complete and useable. May have flaws such as tears, pen marks or highlighting, large creases, stains, marks, etc. POOR Extremely well used and has major flaws, which may be too numerous to mention. Item is complete unless noted. More Condition Details Miniatures come unpainted and unassembled, unless specifically noted. Assembly is required for most miniatures and model kits. Boxed Items are listed as "code/code" where the first code represents the box, and the second code describes the contents. When only one condition is listed, then the box and contents are in the same condition. If a book is listed in the same fashion, the first code represents the cover, and the second code the interior. For example a boxed game listed as VG / NM indicates that the outer box is in Very Good Condition, while the contents are in Near Mint Condition. A "+" (plus) sign indicates that an item is close to the next highest condition. Example, EX+ is an item between Excellent and Near Mint condition. A "-" (minus) sign indicates the opposite. Major defects and/or missing components are noted separately. Boardgame Counters are punched, unless noted. Due to the nature of loose counters, if a game is unplayable we will send you the parts or it may be returned for a refund of the purchase price. Dice In most cases, boxed games and box sets do not come with dice. Cardboard Backing of miniature packs is not graded. If excessively worn, they will be marked as "card worn." original265.ebayDescriptionText: The product is a brand new sealed SimCity 3000 PC CD-Rom released in 1998. This game is part of the popular SimCity series and features new cities to import, manage, and play as. With a rating of E-Everyone, players can enjoy the simulation and compilation aspects of the game, as well as multiplayer and online playability. Published by Electronic Arts in the United States, this gold edition includes the manual and offers a complete edition experience for fans of the franchise. Shipping & Handling: Item is shipped within 2-3 days via USPS Media Mail which includes tracking to allow you to follow the delivery of this manual from our door step to yours. If you are interested in other items in my store I do provide combined shipping to save you your hard earned money. Please contact me prior to purchase so we can work out the details & possibly save you more by making a better deal on what you want than what the items are listed for.                                                                                                                    Pricing:      I try to price items competitively, it is not to say that my prices are carved in stone, but written in sand & willing to negotiate a mutually agreeable price. If you do submit an offer all I ask is to make it a reasonable offer, which you can research via the “Research” tab in the Seller’s Hub of your eBay account which is what I used to provide offers & counter offer. Another note is that if you click on "watch" this listing eBay does not provide the name of the potential buyer, which is why I recommend reaching out to me via eBay message for more fluid communication.   Thank you for visiting a U.S. Military Veteran owned & operated store. Fair winds & following seas....
